description: Source code for the GameManager class of a 2048 game implementation, managing game state, tile movements, and interactions with input, display, and storage modules.

classes.name: GameManager
classes.description: Main class managing the game logic, including setup, moves, state serialization, and interactions with input, display, and storage modules.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the game by clearing the game state and resetting the game setup.

methods.name: keepPlaying
methods.description: Allows the game to continue after reaching 2048 tile, preventing game over.

methods.name: isGameTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the game is over or has been won without the player choosing to keep playing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the game state, either from previous saved state or fresh, and adds starting tiles.

methods.name: addStartTiles
methods.description: Adds initial tiles to the grid at game start.

methods.name: addRandomTile
methods.description: Adds a new tile with value 2 or 4 at a random available position.

methods.name: actuate
methods.description: Updates storage and display with current game state.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the current game state into an object.

methods.name: prepareTiles
methods.description: Prepares tiles for movement by saving positions and clearing merge info.

methods.name: moveTile
methods.description: Moves a tile to a specified cell and updates its position.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Executes a move in the specified direction, merging tiles as appropriate, and adds a new tile.

methods.name: getVector
methods.description: Returns movement vector for a given direction.

methods.name: buildTraversals
methods.description: Builds traversal order for grid cells based on movement vector.

methods.name: findFarthestPosition
methods.description: Finds the farthest position a tile can move to in a given direction.

methods.name: movesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if any moves are available.

methods.name: tileMatchesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if any adjacent tiles can be merged.

methods.name: positionsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two positions are the same.
